title: Garam Masala Comedy Dating Show: Shacking Up In Chicago
description: NYC's #1 Dating Show, NOW IN CHICAGO! Watch as a couple embarks on a first date in front of a LIVE studio audience + singles mixer.
long_description:
NYC's #1 Dating Show, NOW IN CHICAGO! Watch as a couple embarks on a first date in front of a LIVE studio audience + singles mixer.

About this Event

Two strangers. One stage. A packed room full of people who came to watch it all go down.
Garam Masala Dating is NYC's #1 live comedy dating show, now on tour. Every show, we put a real couple on a blind date in front of a live audience while hosts Surbhi and Wyatt Feegrado play wingman, roast them and try to keep things from going completely off the rails!
And if you in the audience are single and like what you see, you can actually steal one of the daters for yourself! Right there. On stage. In front of everyone.
More details - www.garammasaladating.com/apply After the show, the night continues with an afterparty so the shy folks can try to shoot their shot with our amazing contestants as well!
What to expect:
A full live blind date with all the awkward, hilarious, romantic moments you'd normally only hear about secondhandThe chance to jump on stage and steal a single for yourselfA singles mixer after the show (yes, people actually exchange numbers)Two hours of comedy, chaos and genuine connectionA packed room of 200+ people who are all here because they love a good timeYou don't need to be single. You don't need to be South Asian. You just need to show up ready to laugh.
4 seasons. 40+ shows. 50 million views on our clips. Over 200,000 followers across platforms. This is the show everyone keeps telling you about.
Doors open at 5:30pm. Show starts at 6pm sharp.
Directions: The Lincoln Lodge Mainstage 2040 N Milwaukee Ave, Chicago, IL 60647
Join us for an unforgettable night and see why Garam Masala is the hottest comedy dating show in the city!
Additional Information:
Tickets are non-refundable.
As an attendee, you agree to be recorded and consent to the use of the resulting content for promotional purposes.
